annotations.title: Find where a state, county or city posts its bids

description:
Where to bid in a place: the state's, county's or city's own bid / procurement portal,
    the platform it runs on (Bonfire, OpenGov, DemandStar, PlanetBids, BidNet Direct...), its open
    bids list when known (open_bids_url: give that link first), department bid pages (more_links),
    where vendors register, and the levels above it (a city's county and state). Covers every state and
    territory, every county with a county government and the cities and towns of 10,000+; a smaller place gets its state's
    portal. status: confirmed (the bid page was checked), listed (added by hand; the site blocks
    automated checks) or site_only (only the official site so far: say the bid page isn't
    confirmed; no site means no working official website was found, so point to the county and
    state instead). in_spendquery: sources whose bids or contracts search_local_bids already has.
    SpendQuery links to these portals; it doesn't copy their bids.
